name: HP
desc: Hit points. The unit is out of the game if this reaches 0.

name: Str
desc: Strength. This affects damage the unit deals with physical attacks.

name: Mys
desc: Mysticism. This affects non-physical attacks damage and medical pods effectiveness.

name: Dex
desc: Dexterity. A higher number improves accuracy and frequency of critical hits.

name: Spd
desc: Speed. This affects both evasion and attack speed.

name: Luck
desc:
Luck. Has various effects.
Lowers risk of enemy critical hits.

name: Def
desc:
Defense. Reduces damage
from physical attacks.

name: Res
desc: Resistance. Reduces damage from non-physical attacks.

name: Move
desc:
Movement. The normal distance
the unit can cross in 1 turn.

name: Con
desc: Constitution. Affects how well the unit can wield heavier weapons.
